nodes.label: The same sepsis spec runs under interchangeable engines. The two full-physics...
nodes.statement: The same sepsis spec runs under interchangeable engines. The two full-physics engines agree on the inflammation core — that is the composition proof. They diverge on the hemodynamic layer, which study 05 is set up to settle. The surrogate is interchangeable at the interface; its accuracy is deferred to study 04.

nodes.label: The PyTorch surrogate is the third interchangeable engine at the interface. I...
nodes.statement: The PyTorch surrogate is the third interchangeable engine at the interface. It constructs over the same 91-state sepsis spec and completes a full 48 h / 576-step rollout live (0.198 s, finite but out of physical range). Swapping to it is one node-address change, like swapping BioGears for exact Tellurium. That is interchangeability of interface; speed is deferred to study 04 and accuracy to study 05.

nodes.label: The hemodynamic divergence is not transcription noise. It is two internally c...
nodes.statement: The hemodynamic divergence is not transcription noise. It is two internally consistent, opposite shock trajectories: the engine reaches MAP<65 by a hypodynamic low-output route (69.3 h), the extraction by a hyperdynamic vasodilatory route (54.1 h). The ~15 h timing gap — earlier even though the extraction lags ~11 h on systolic pressure — and the engine's continuous fluctuation against the extraction's near-flat profile both point to the vasomotor, fluid, and metabolic subsystems the extraction omits, not to a faithfulness failure in the shared spec.
